description: NaMnAsO₄ is Spinel-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.51 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-69°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.37 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-61°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.74 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Mn, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one As atom.
